name: Kageura Yuuji
source:
A male student in the art club.
He enjoys drawing pictures, but can only draw the female body properly.
His long bangs usually obscure his expression, and he is seen as a dark figure who does not relate to his surroundings, and is treated as almost a nobody in the school.
Because of this, even his classmates, who spend every day in the same classroom with him, cannot remember what he looks like.
He takes advantage of this fact when he rapes the heroine, pretending to be someone else by putting his bangs up and exposing his face, thereby hiding his true identity.

He has a desire in his heart to play with women, and every day he imagines fucking Ryone, who is in the same class as him.
He has been training himself to imagine the lewdness of Ryone in his mind and draw her in his mind's eye every day.
As a result, when he awakens with the ability to take control of the human body, he is able to "manipulate another person's body just by thinking about it" without difficulty.

While blessed with unique abilities, his physical abilities are not high, and his body is rather slender.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1142377]Getchu[/url]]
